summary: The Verification Contract can now declare that a project's Delivery PR checks come from outside its repository workflows, such as an external CI or an organization-level required workflow, with pull_request_check_source: external and a pull_request_check_provider label. Execution approval then requires no workflow and states that merge-pr still merges only on green checks, render-ci refuses to materialize a workflow for that contract, and the operation compiler refuses an unknown source, an external source without a provider and a provider for a repository workflow. A contract without the field keeps the repository workflow requirement. The two properties are new vault property types, so an existing project runs the setup package refresh after upgrading; until then the vault check reports them in .obsidian/types.json.
